caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, decorative plate with a scalloped edge. The plate features intricate embossed or engraved designs of strawberries, strawberry leaves, and small strawberry flowers arranged symmetrically around both the center and the outer region. The central part of the plate has a smaller circular section also decorated with similar botanical motifs. The overall color scheme of the drawing is monochromatic, using shades of gray and light blue against a beige or off-white background. There is a small, detailed side-view illustration of the plate in the bottom right corner, and two sets of small printed text appear at the lower left and lower right areas near the plate.
title: Strawberry Design Plate
